merciMourad.tagline: Building a firm of excellence means, above all, building men and women of <accent>trust</accent>.
merciMourad.bio1: Mourad Guellaty devoted his life to public accountancy and audit in Tunisia. As the former and first President of the Tunisian Order of Chartered Accountants, he championed the voice of the profession with independence and commitment.
merciMourad.bio2: His visionary leadership enabled the firm to extend its reach far beyond borders, supporting the largest Tunisian and international companies in their most strategic challenges.

merciMourad.quote:
Trust cannot be decreed.
It is built, year after year, in the service of our clients and of excellence.
merciMourad.walidRoleTitle: Chartered accountant and statutory auditor (<accent>Tunisia & France</accent>), Managing Partner.
merciMourad.walidBio1: Walid Moussa spent 10 years at KPMG Audit Paris (France) in audit and advisory, before joining Cabinet Mourad Guellaty & Associates in Tunisia in 2014.
merciMourad.walidBio2: With 20 years of experience, he has a thorough command of audit engagements (social accounts, consolidated accounts, reporting), both internationally and nationally, with strong knowledge of IFRS standards.
merciMourad.walidBio3: He has regularly carried out advisory and audit engagements in an international environment, including for listed companies, and headed the coordination of international audits for major foreign industrial groups.
merciMourad.walidBio4: Since 2014, he has audited international and national groups across various sectors: industry, the financial sector, pharmaceuticals and information technology.

about.title: A trusted partner for informed decisions
about.p1: Cabinet Mourad Guellaty is a public accountancy, audit and advisory firm based in La Marsa, Tunis. Founded by Mourad Guellaty, former and first President of the Tunisian Order of Chartered Accountants, the firm supports local and international companies in their financial challenges.
about.p2: Specialised in statutory auditing, financial audit, management advisory and consulting, we put our expertise at the service of your performance.

team.title: A multidisciplinary team at the service of your performance
team.description: MG & Associates brings together chartered accountants, statutory auditors and specialised advisors, able to work across all the professions of finance, audit and advisory.

bios.haythem: With over 15 years of solid experience in auditing and statutory auditing of public enterprises and institutions, he has for many years supported organisations of various sizes and sectors of activity. His expertise covers statutory audit engagements, assessment of internal control systems, risk analysis and support for governance and transformation projects in the public sector.
bios.salem: He has a recognised experience of over 15 years in auditing banks and resident financial institutions. Throughout his career, he has conducted numerous engagements for banking institutions, leasing companies and other financial players. His expertise covers prudential requirements, internal control, risk management and the accounting issues specific to financial institutions.
bios.sofiene: A specialist in international financial reporting standards (IFRS) and the consolidation of financial statements, he supports national and international groups in their financial reporting projects. His experience covers complex consolidations, conversions to IFRS frameworks, technical assistance to finance departments as well as the handling of highly technical accounting matters.
bios.hafedh: He has in-depth expertise in auditing banks and non-resident financial institutions operating in Tunisia. His experience allows him to carry out engagements combining local regulatory requirements, international audit standards as well as specific issues relating to cross-border financial activities and risk management.
bios.ayman: He has significant experience in auditing industrial companies operating in various sectors. His expertise covers the analysis of industrial processes, the assessment of internal control systems, the management of operational risks and support for industrial groups. He works on tax advisory assignments, compliance reviews, assistance during tax inspections and tax optimisation in compliance with applicable regulations.

faq.q1: How does the recruitment process work?
faq.a1: Our process takes place in several stages: review of your application, an interview with HR, then a meeting with the relevant team. We aim to offer you a transparent experience that respects your time.
faq.q2: What profiles are you looking for?
faq.a2: We are looking for passionate, rigorous talents driven by excellence: chartered accountants, auditors, tax advisors and lawyers, as well as junior profiles at the start of their careers.
faq.a3: Yes, all our internships are paid in accordance with applicable regulations. We offer an environment conducive to learning and skills development.
faq.a4: Our assignments mainly take place at our offices in La Marsa, Tunis, as well as at our clients' premises across Tunisia.
faq.q5: Can I send a spontaneous application?
faq.a5: Absolutely. We are always looking for talent. You can send your application to contact@cabinetguellaty.com and we will review it carefully.

audit-legal.title: Statutory Audit
audit-legal.desc: Statutory auditing and legal audit in compliance with applicable standards.
audit-legal.intro: Statutory audit is the historical core of our profession. As statutory auditors, we certify the regularity and truthfulness of your financial statements in accordance with Tunisian and international standards.
points: Certification of social and consolidated accounts
Audit of financial statements under IFRS
Special reports of the statutory auditor
Assistance to governance bodies (board of directors, audit committees)

conseil-fiscal.title: Tax Advisory
conseil-fiscal.desc: Tax optimisation, filings and assistance in your dealings with the tax authorities.
conseil-fiscal.intro: Our tax team supports you in securing and optimising your tax position. We act both in advisory and in disputes, with in-depth knowledge of the Tunisian tax administration.
points: Tax optimisation and structuring of your tax position
Preparation and follow-up of filings (CIT, VAT, personal income tax)
Management of tax inspections and disputes
Applications for approvals, waivers and stays
Tax watch and impact of finance laws

expertise-comptable.title: Public Accounting
expertise-comptable.desc: Bookkeeping and accounting reviews, reliable financial statements and reporting for better decision-making.
expertise-comptable.intro: We take care of your accounting with rigour and responsiveness, from bookkeeping to the production of financial statements, so that you can remain fully focused on your business.

conseil-juridique.title: Legal Advisory
conseil-juridique.desc: Legal support for companies and securing of your operations.
conseil-juridique.intro: We secure your decisions and operations from a legal standpoint, in close collaboration with your advisors, to offer you a complete and coherent picture.
points: Drafting and review of commercial contracts
Mergers, demergers and partial asset contributions
Support in social and labour law

conseil-en-gestion.title: Management Advisory
conseil-en-gestion.desc: Financial analysis, dashboards and performance support.
conseil-en-gestion.intro: We help you steer your company with effective management tools: financial analysis, budgeting and support for strategic decisions.

transactions-due-diligence.title: Transactions & Due Diligence
transactions-due-diligence.desc: Valuation, acquisition audit and support for your strategic operations.
transactions-due-diligence.intro: We assist you in your external growth, acquisition or disposal operations, with in-depth analysis of the risks and value of the target.
points: Financial, tax and legal due diligence

creation-societe-tunisie.title: Company Incorporation in Tunisia
creation-societe-tunisie.desc: Complete support for your establishment project: legal form, registration and formalities.
creation-societe-tunisie.intro: From validating your project to its operational launch, we support you through every stage of incorporating your company in Tunisia, for both residents and foreign investors.
points: Choice of the appropriate legal form (SARL, SA, SUARL, branch)
Drafting of articles and incorporation formalities
Registration with the National Register of Enterprises
Opening of the bank account and deposit of capital
Tax registration and CNSS / social security affiliation
Advice on tax incentives (investment incentives code)

assistance-comptable-fiscale-juridique-t.title: Accounting, Tax & Legal Assistance
assistance-comptable-fiscale-juridique-t.desc: A single point of contact for the accounting, tax and legal management of your activity in Tunisia.
assistance-comptable-fiscale-juridique-t.intro: Our global assistance package offers you ongoing support across all your accounting, tax and legal obligations, with a single point of contact and multidisciplinary teams.
points: Management of all tax and social deadlines
Support for foreign and non-resident investors
